{{Quote|Gentle rolling plains with occasional insect plagues.|Description}}
The '''Ozmonfield''' {{J|オズモーネ平原|Ozumōne Heigen}} is a location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It is a version of the [[Ozmone Plain]] that appears in ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]''. Though both games are set in the same world of [[Ivalice]], the ''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance'' Ivalice is in fact a dream world version of the world in ''[[Final Fantasy XII]]'', and so some place names are bound to be similar, but not exactly the same. Ozmonfield is unlocked after "Mission #066: Dargon's Aid" is completed and is the site of "Mission #090: Clan Law". It can be freed in "Mission #263: Ozmonfield" after the main game is cleared.

*"Mission #090: Clan Law"

*"Mission #263: Ozmonfield
{{Quote|The chomper beetles found in Ozmonfield are eating my chocobo feed. Please use this "bug-B-gone" to drive them away!|Dalaben, Ranch Manager}}
